review.description: S1-S4 layered registry ownership, generated documentation, reviewed fingerprints and fail-closed verification remain unchanged. New recovery terms/entities/scenarios/assertion anchors extend product contracts while preserving historical adoption base and list.

No runner, adoption policy, reconciliation implementation or required skill definition changed. Fresh records are generated against the public 9cd2c99 baseline, not copied from private pilot history.
